categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily develops and sells server motherboards and systems, focusing on high-performance computing servers, cloud servers, edge servers, 5G multi-access edge computing servers, and distributed servers for video streaming. It serves data centers, HPC, big data, cloud computing, and visual computing markets, offering products through distributors and ODM-Direct business models.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including ARM CPUs, Intel Xeon (4th/5th generation Emerald Rapids), AMD EPYC processors, PCIe Gen4/Gen5, NVMe, and complies with OCP specifications. It integrates high-density servers with NVIDIA Grace Hopper and AMD MI300 GPUs, employing cutting-edge water cooling and thermal management technologies. Manufacturing is fully outsourced to professional foundries with a mix of consigned and ODM production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include data centers and cloud service providers in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Greater China. The company targets cloud computing, AI, 5G telecom operators, and enterprises requiring high-performance and edge computing servers. Major customers include leading cloud service providers and content delivery networks.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant sales in the Americas, Europe, and Asia, especially in the Greater China region. It has no subsidiaries or branches but serves international markets through distributors and direct ODM partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment as a server motherboard and system ODM/ODM-Direct manufacturer, sourcing key components like ICs, chips, and passive components from upstream semiconductor and component suppliers, and delivering finished server products downstream to cloud service providers and enterprise customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing R&D capabilities to develop high-performance, energy-efficient servers supporting AI, 5G, edge computing, and cloud applications. The company invests in next-gen processor platforms, accelerated computing with GPUs, advanced cooling solutions, and compliance with industry standards like OCP. It aims to expand ODM-Direct partnerships and regional supply chain resilience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of server motherboards and complete server systems. The company employs ODM-Direct business models and sales via distributors, focusing on customized solutions for large-scale data center and cloud customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While the company holds less than 10% of the global server shipment market, it competes by focusing on high-value, customized server solutions rather than price competition. It positions itself as a flexible, innovative ODM partner with strong R&D and quality reputation, competing against larger server ODMs and system integrators.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved record revenue of approximately NT$8.8 billion, a 222% increase year-over-year, with net profit surging over 60-fold. The company has shown rapid growth driven by AI server demand and expanded shipments. It maintains a lean organization with around 340 employees, including 280+ R&D staff, and invests significantly in R&D (~8.4% of revenue).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes rapid innovation, high-quality server products tailored to customer-specific workloads, and advanced thermal management. Its ODM-Direct model allows close collaboration with top cloud and CDN providers, delivering flexible, high-performance, and cost-effective server solutions that support emerging AI, 5G, and edge computing demands.
